title: "2 Chronicles"

# 2 Chronicles

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

2 Chronicles focuses on Judah's kings and the Temple, emphasizing revival, repentance, and God's faithfulness. The book teaches that sincere repentance brings restoration.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 1:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Give me wisdom and knowledge</div>

### Why This Verse

Solomon's request

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Solomon's request for wisdom. The key verse highlights the importance of seeking God's wisdom above personal gain.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 2:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Who is able to build Him a house?</div>

### Why This Verse

God's greatness emphasized

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes preparations for building the Temple. The key verse emphasizes worship as the central purpose of the kingdom.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 3:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Mount Moriah</div>

### Why This Verse

Temple location identified

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the construction of the Temple. The key verse highlights the fulfillment of God's plan for a permanent place of worship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 4:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Huram finished the work</div>

### Why This Verse

Temple furnishings completed

### Chapter Insight

This chapter details the Temple furnishings. The key verse emphasizes the beauty and completeness of worship devoted to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 5:13</div>

<div class="identifier">For He is good; His mercy endures forever</div>

### Why This Verse

Glory fills the temple

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the ark being brought into the Temple. The key verse marks the manifestation of God's glory among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 6:14</div>

<div class="identifier">There is no God like You</div>

### Why This Verse

Solomon's prayer

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Solomon's prayer of dedication. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness to His covenant promises.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 7:14</div>

<div class="identifier">If My people who are called by My name</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses in the OT

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records God's response to Solomon. The key verse reveals God's promise of forgiveness and restoration through repentance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 8:16</div>

<div class="identifier">All the work of Solomon was prepared</div>

### Why This Verse

Temple fully established

### Chapter Insight

This chapter summarizes Solomon's accomplishments. The key verse highlights faithful completion of God's work.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 9:8</div>

<div class="identifier">Blessed be the LORD thy God</div>

### Why This Verse

Queen of Sheba's praise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the visit of the Queen of Sheba and Solomon's greatness. The key verse demonstrates how God's blessing became a testimony to the nations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 10:16</div>

<div class="identifier">What portion have we in David?</div>

### Why This Verse

Kingdom divided

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the division of the kingdom. The key verse illustrates the consequences of pride and rejecting wise counsel.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 11:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Those who set their hearts to seek the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Faithful remnant

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Rehoboam's early reforms and strengthening of Judah. The key verse emphasizes seeking God as the source of stability.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 12:6</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD is righteous</div>

### Why This Verse

Rehoboam's humility

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Rehoboam's decline and humiliation. The key verse demonstrates the dangers of forsaking God's law.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 13:12</div>

<div class="identifier">God Himself is with us</div>

### Why This Verse

Abijah's declaration

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Abijah's victory over Israel. The key verse highlights trust in God's covenant faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 14:11</div>

<div class="identifier">It is nothing with Thee to help</div>

### Why This Verse

Asa's prayer of faith

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Asa's reforms and victory over Ethiopia. The key verse emphasizes reliance upon God rather than human strength.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 15:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Be ye strong therefore</div>

### Why This Verse

Encouragement to perseverance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records covenant renewal under Asa. The key verse calls God's people to seek Him wholeheartedly.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 16:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The eyes of the LORD run to and fro</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Chronicles' most famous verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Asa's later failures. The key verse teaches that God's eyes seek those fully devoted to Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 17:6</div>

<div class="identifier">His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Jehoshaphat's devotion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter highlights Jehoshaphat's faithfulness and prosperity. The key verse emphasizes obedience and trust in God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 18:13</div>

<div class="identifier">What my God saith, that will I speak</div>

### Why This Verse

Micaiah's faithfulness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jehoshaphat's alliance with Ahab. The key verse warns against compromising with ungodly influences.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 19:7</div>

<div class="identifier">There is no iniquity with the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Judicial integrity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts judicial reforms in Judah. The key verse emphasizes justice rooted in the fear of God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 20:15</div>

<div class="identifier">The battle is not yours, but God's</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the Bible's best-known promises

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Judah's deliverance from overwhelming enemies. The key verse teaches that victory belongs to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 21:20</div>

<div class="identifier">He departed without being desired</div>

### Why This Verse

Judgment on Jehoram

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Jehoram's wicked reign. The key verse illustrates the consequences of abandoning God's ways.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 22:7</div>

<div class="identifier">The destruction of Ahaziah was of God</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine sovereignty

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Ahaziah's brief and corrupt reign. The key verse demonstrates the destructive influence of ungodly counsel.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 23:16</div>

<div class="identifier">Jehoiada made a covenant</div>

### Why This Verse

National renewal

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the preservation and coronation of Joash. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness to the Davidic covenant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 24:20</div>

<div class="identifier">Why transgress the commandments of the LORD?</div>

### Why This Verse

Zechariah's rebuke

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Joash's reforms and later apostasy. The key verse emphasizes the danger of abandoning God after early faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 25:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD is able to give thee much more than this</div>

### Why This Verse

Trust over financial loss

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Amaziah's successes and failures. The key verse warns against pride following victory.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 26:16</div>

<div class="identifier">When he was strong, his heart was lifted up</div>

### Why This Verse

Uzziah's downfall

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Uzziah's prosperous reign and downfall. The key verse demonstrates that pride can destroy even successful leaders.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 27:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Jotham became mighty because he prepared his ways</div>

### Why This Verse

Leadership principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jotham's faithful reign. The key verse highlights steady obedience and personal faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 28:22</div>

<div class="identifier">In the time of his distress he trespassed yet more</div>

### Why This Verse

Ahaz's apostasy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Ahaz's wickedness and idolatry. The key verse reveals the consequences of trusting false gods.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 29

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 29:36</div>

<div class="identifier">God had prepared the people</div>

### Why This Verse

Hezekiah's revival

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Hezekiah's cleansing of the Temple. The key verse emphasizes spiritual renewal through returning to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 30

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 30:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD is gracious and merciful</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to repentance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Hezekiah's Passover celebration. The key verse highlights God's willingness to forgive those who seek Him sincerely.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 31

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 31:21</div>

<div class="identifier">He prospered because he sought God</div>

### Why This Verse

Hezekiah's success

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records reforms supporting worship and the priesthood. The key verse demonstrates the blessings of faithful stewardship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 32

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 32:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Be strong and courageous</div>

### Why This Verse

Hezekiah encourages Judah

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts God's deliverance from Assyria. The key verse emphasizes trust in God's power rather than fear of enemies.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 33

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 33:13</div>

<div class="identifier">He prayed unto Him, and He was entreated</div>

### Why This Verse

Manasseh's repentance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Manasseh's wickedness and later repentance. The key verse demonstrates the depth of God's mercy toward the repentant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 34

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 34:31</div>

<div class="identifier">The king stood and made a covenant</div>

### Why This Verse

Josiah's reform

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Josiah's reforms and the rediscovery of the Law. The key verse highlights the transforming power of God's word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 35

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 35:21</div>

<div class="identifier">God commanded me to make haste</div>

### Why This Verse

Josiah and Necho

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Josiah's Passover and death. The key verse emphasizes devotion to worship and covenant faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 36

<div class="key-verse">2 Chronicles 36:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Who is among you of all His people? Let him go up</div>

### Why This Verse

Closing call to r

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Judah's fall and the beginning of restoration. The key verse demonstrates God's faithfulness even in judgment by preserving hope for return.
:::
